ops.title: Container sandbox-chain host launch + supervisor (2f) open decisions
ops.body:
How the container sandbox chain runs on the fleet HOST (from the prototype), + the decisions the Phase 2f supervisor must resolve (not just replicate). Grounds the `write_container_agent` supervisor + egress pf (2e). Sourced from the sandbox-chain recon over `~/.yclaw/spike-container/` + cc-notes log `apple-container-prototype`.

## Launch chain (order matters)
1. **`container system start`** (apple/container 1.1.0) — one atomic step brings up 4 processes: `container-apiserver`, `machine-apiserver`, `container-network-vmnet start --id default --mode nat --subnet 192.168.72.1/24 --subnet-v6 fd00:c0de::/64` (subnet override from `~/.config/container/config.toml` `[network] subnet/subnetv6`), `container-core-images`. These register as launchd jobs **dynamically with NO on-disk plist** → do not survive reboot (structural confirmation of #158/#286). config.toml MUST be written before the first-ever start (192.168.72/73 avoids the fleet's 64.x).
2. **socktainer** `/opt/homebrew/opt/socktainer/bin/socktainer` (brew v1.1.1, **no flags**). Listens on `~/.socktainer/container.sock` (default derived from `$HOME`; the brew-services path only applies under a scoped HOME). Socket perm **0666 world-writable** — LOAD-BEARING invariant (isolation holds only because the agent is in a micro-VM): the raw socktainer socket must NEVER be bind-mounted into the agent container. Boot-checks the apiserver's version, so must start after step 1.
3. **hermes-docker-proxy** (production: the repo binary `pkgs/hermes-docker-proxy` with the landed da1c63 fix — NOT the scratch `~/.yclaw/spike-container/bin/hermes-docker-proxy-patched`, which only has the first-pass forbiddenDest). Env-driven, no args: `HERMES_DOCKER_PROXY_LISTEN=<downstream socket the agent mounts>`, `HERMES_DOCKER_PROXY_UPSTREAM=~/.socktainer/container.sock`, `HERMES_DOCKER_PROXY_BIND_ROOTS=<agent stateDir>`. main.go chmods the listen socket 0660 but **never chowns** — the socket's group = the process's primary gid. Dials upstream lazily per-request (proxy start doesn't need socktainer up yet).
4. **agent container** `container run --name hermes --cap-add NET_ADMIN` (NET_ADMIN required + verified for real-tun) with the 4 secret/config mounts + the proxy-socket mount + image `hermes-agent:latest`. Must come last (needs the proxy socket).

## Open decisions the supervisor must MAKE
1. **gid-1000 for the proxy socket** — the container's dropped user is uid/gid 1000; the proxy socket is 0660 and must be group-owned gid 1000 so the agent can connect. Nothing sets this on macOS (no `hermes` group at 1000, binary doesn't chown). Options: run the host proxy under a dedicated gid-1000 group, or `chown :1000` the socket after bind. RESOLVE in 2f.
2. **Real macOS host path for the proxy socket** — the image.nix `/run/hermes-docker-proxy/docker.sock` is a Linux-guest path; macOS has no `/run`. Pick a host dir (e.g. under `~/.yclaw/run/` or a created `/var/run/...`), create it, mount it at the container's expected `/run/hermes-docker-proxy/docker.sock`.
3. **Agent container network** — RESOLVED by E3 + production intent: use the **default NAT network** (reaches internet + host tailscale services), NOT a custom isolated net (E3: custom/hostOnly net = ZERO egress). Then narrow egress with pf (2e): block non-tailscale internet + fleet, allow the container's own tailscale WG/DERP egress. Update image.nix's `--network <custom-non-nat-net>` placeholder accordingly. (The egress pf ruleset is the security knife-edge — still UNPROVEN; B2 never ran, needs a sudo-gated live test.)
4. **Supervision** — all of `container system start` + socktainer + proxy + agent container have ZERO supervision today (nohup orphans / dynamic launchd jobs). The 2f `write_container_agent` KeepAlive LaunchAgent (gui domain, per-user, since apiserver is a per-user job) is the entire lifecycle fix: RunAtLoad + resident re-assert loop that re-runs `container system start`, restarts socktainer + proxy if dead, and (re)starts the agent container.

See [[apple-container-prototype-verdict]] and [[Phase 2a/2b done: container-hermes OCI image loads + smoke-passes on host]].
